class.name: ResonanceReverbDataPoint
class.brief_description: Analysis marker to sample baked reverb at a world point (RT60 and energy). Does not affect audio.
class.description: Place under or near a baked [ResonanceProbeVolume]. When [member probe_data] is empty, inherits [member ResonanceProbeVolume.probe_data] from an ancestor. Inspector button Sample Reverb Here initializes [ResonanceServer] like Bake and shows RT60 and energy; in Play it samples once when ready. Analysis only; not used for runtime convolution.

method.name: query_baked_reverb
method.description: Sample baked reflections at this node's global position. Success includes energy and RT60 fields; failure sets [code]ok[/code] false. Needs a live [ResonanceServer] IPL context (Sample button or Play).

method.name: query_baked_reverb_at
method.description: Same as [method query_baked_reverb] at an explicit world position.

members.member: Baked probe batch to read. Auto-filled from an ancestor [ResonanceProbeVolume] when empty.
Layer to read: Reverb (0), Static Source (1), Static Listener (2). Static layers show [member static_endpoint] and [member static_influence_radius].
Endpoint position for Static Source or Static Listener layers (hidden for Reverb).
Influence sphere radius for static endpoint layers. 0 uses the baker fallback (10 m). Hidden for Reverb.
Only probes within this distance (meters) contribute to interpolation. Drawn as a wire sphere in the editor.
When true, [method query_baked_reverb] also builds IR preview stats (duration / peak). Analysis only.
Script-readable snapshot from the most recent sample. Hidden from the inspector.
